headline: Pick discipline over convenience—start today.
summary: You're gaining 0.69 kg weekly when you need to lose 0.81 kg; today you choose portion control and movement over patterns.
details: Today: use Huel portions strictly—no emotional snacking or extra bites outside your pre-portioned meals. Hit the rowing machine for 40 minutes or treadmill for 30–35 minutes; that's your non-negotiable movement. This is where you break the +2.1 kg monthly trend—every day of discipline compounds, and you're 10 months from 88 kg with zero margin left.
